title: Signal: Dockerfile served from the web root
scope: One response body containing Dockerfile build instructions.
limitations: One response body. The rule reads the build instruction shape; it does not resolve the base image or prove that a build argument in it is still valid.

observation.body:
FROM node:20-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev
COPY . .
CMD ["node","server.js"]

FROM python:3.12-slim
ARG PIP_INDEX_URL
RUN pip install -r requirements.txt
COPY app /app
Write a Dockerfile with a pinned base image and a single RUN layer.

fpNotes: A page that shows a Dockerfile inside a documentation code block is reported when it reproduces two instruction lines at line starts; the rule reads the document shape rather than its origin.
